title: Driver Gaze Target Identification via Gaze Estimation and Structured Driving Scene Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.25771v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identifying a driver's gaze target provides object-level information for visual attention monitoring in intelligent vehicles. Gaze-zone classification and continuous attention localization provide limited information about the identity of the attended scene target. This paper proposes a modular framework that identifies object- or region-level gaze targets from synchronized in-cabin driver images and forward-view road images. The framework comprises four components: MFGaze, which combines a Vision Transformer pretrained with a masked autoencoder (MAE) and head-pose conditioning through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM); panoptic scene understanding, which constructs a structured candidate set; polynomial ridge regression, which maps gaze features to 2D scene-image coordinates through individualized calibration; and entropy-driven target inference, which adaptively fuses boundary-distance geometry with class-level semantic priors. translated_title: 基于视线估计与结构化驾驶场景理解的驾驶员注视目标识别
translated_abstract: 识别驾驶员的注视目标可以为智能车辆中的视觉注意力监测提供目标级信息。视线区域分类和连续注意力定位所能提供的关于被注视场景目标身份的信息较为有限。本文提出了一种模块化框架，从同步采集的车舱内驾驶员图像和前视道路图像中识别目标级或区域级的注视目标。该框架包含四个组成部分：MFGaze，它将使用掩码自编码器（MAE）预训练的视觉Transformer与通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）实现的头部姿态条件化相结合；全景场景理解，用于构建结构化的候选目标集合；多项式岭回归，通过个性化校准将视线特征映射到二维场景图像坐标；以及熵驱动的目标推断，自适应地融合边界距离几何信息与类别级语义先验。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种模块化框架，通过融合MAE预训练视觉Transformer视线估计、全景场景理解、个性化校准和熵驱动的目标推断，从车内驾驶员图像与前视道路图像中实现目标级的驾驶员注视目标识别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modular framework that identifies object-level driver gaze targets by combining MAE-pretrained Vision Transformer gaze estimation, panoptic scene understanding, individualized calibration, and entropy-driven target inference from synchronized in-cabin and forward-view images.
